 Chet Holmgren personally proved there are no absolutes in Thunder-Spurs rivalry 
 By Miles Leicht | Oct 22, 2026, 5:00 AM EDT Share on Facebook Share on X Share on Reddit Copy Article Add us as a preferred source Oct 20, 2026; San Antonio, Texas, USA; Oklahoma City Thunder center Chet Holmgren (7) goes up in between San Antonio Spurs guards Stephon Castle (5) and De'aaron Fox (4) in the first at Frost Bank Center. Mandatory Credit: Daniel Dunn-Imagn Images | IMAGN IMAGES via Reuters Connect There aren't many better ways the 2026-27 NBA season could've started for the OKC Thunder.
--> There aren't many better ways the 2026-27 NBA season could've started for the OKC Thunder.
 Oklahoma City got its long-awaited revenge against the San Antonio Spurs in a 116-104 victory Tuesday night. There are positives on all fronts for OKC, but the most needed, and maybe one of the more surprising turnouts, was the assertive two-way play of Chet Holmgren.
--> Oklahoma City got its long-awaited revenge against the San Antonio Spurs in a 116-104 victory Tuesday night. There are positives on all fronts for OKC, but the most needed, and maybe one of the more surprising turnouts, was the assertive two-way play of Chet Holmgren.
 After his abysmal four points and four rebounds in their ill-fated Western Conference Finals Game 7 matchup against the Spurs, many wrote him off as an ineffective weapon in the matchup.
--> After his abysmal four points and four rebounds in their ill-fated Western Conference Finals Game 7 matchup against the Spurs, many wrote him off as an ineffective weapon in the matchup.
 Of course, as made evident in their season opener, this couldn't be further from the truth.
--> Of course, as made evident in their season opener, this couldn't be further from the truth.
 Holmgren took command in his latest bout against San Antonio, serving as the primary defender for Victor Wembanyama, who, not coincidentally, went 1-for-13 from the field.
--> Holmgren took command in his latest bout against San Antonio, serving as the primary defender for Victor Wembanyama, who, not coincidentally, went 1-for-13 from the field.
 On offense, he also showed his force, attacking smaller defenders and showing zero hesitation.
--> On offense, he also showed his force, attacking smaller defenders and showing zero hesitation.
 His performance gives an entirely new outlook on this wondrous rivalry and helps prove he's worth every penny of his $41 million salary.
--> His performance gives an entirely new outlook on this wondrous rivalry and helps prove he's worth every penny of his $41 million salary.
 Chet Holmgren's defensive performance a game-changer for Thunder
--> Chet Holmgren's defensive performance a game-changer for Thunder
 A point of frustration in this matchup has been the lack of Holmgren-Wembanyama matchups, specifically Chet guarding Wemby.
--> A point of frustration in this matchup has been the lack of Holmgren-Wembanyama matchups, specifically Chet guarding Wemby.
 He had only 29 possessions guarding him in their seven-game playoff series, just the third-most on the team.
--> He had only 29 possessions guarding him in their seven-game playoff series, just the third-most on the team.
 Without Holmgren on him, there would be either a drastic size or speed mismatch, ultimately crippling OKC's defense at times.
--> Without Holmgren on him, there would be either a drastic size or speed mismatch, ultimately crippling OKC's defense at times.
 This game, though, the All-Defense member lived up to the honor. He followed Wemby virtually everywhere he went and wasn't afraid to get in body battles under the basket with him.
--> This game, though, the All-Defense member lived up to the honor. He followed Wemby virtually everywhere he went and wasn't afraid to get in body battles under the basket with him.
 This hard-nosed approach flourished, with Chet swatting four shots and personally playing a significant role in Wemby shooting a shockingly bad 7.7 percent from the floor.
--> This hard-nosed approach flourished, with Chet swatting four shots and personally playing a significant role in Wemby shooting a shockingly bad 7.7 percent from the floor.
 The coaches and Holmgren alike have finally put full trust in his impeccable defensive instincts and timing. His defensive prowess was a significant strength all game and helped limit Wemby to only two offensive rebounds and four turnovers. 
--> The coaches and Holmgren alike have finally put full trust in his impeccable defensive instincts and timing. His defensive prowess was a significant strength all game and helped limit Wemby to only two offensive rebounds and four turnovers. 
 His defensive performance was a dream come true for Thunder fans, and his offensive game was the cherry on top.
--> His defensive performance was a dream come true for Thunder fans, and his offensive game was the cherry on top.
 Easy offense everything Thunder fans could have asked for
--> Easy offense everything Thunder fans could have asked for
 Even against non-San Antonio opponents, Chet not attacking mismatches has hurt his offense significantly, but this game was quite the opposite.
--> Even against non-San Antonio opponents, Chet not attacking mismatches has hurt his offense significantly, but this game was quite the opposite.
 Even in an imperfect-scoring game for the Thunder, with Jalen Williams still not his All-Star self , they managed to put up 116 points against one of the best defenses in the NBA.
--> Even in an imperfect-scoring game for the Thunder, with Jalen Williams still not his All-Star self , they managed to put up 116 points against one of the best defenses in the NBA.
 Holmgren's 14 points were a standout, with his eight free throws being the second-most in his career against the Spurs. 
--> Holmgren's 14 points were a standout, with his eight free throws being the second-most in his career against the Spurs. 
 It wasn't pretty at times; he shot just 37.5 percent from the floor, and Wembanyama blocked multiple attempts, but he brought needed pressure inside.
--> It wasn't pretty at times; he shot just 37.5 percent from the floor, and Wembanyama blocked multiple attempts, but he brought needed pressure inside.
 Chet snagged four of the club's 10 offensive rebounds, helping keep the Thunder even on the offensive glass, an area the team was clearly outdueled in during the WCF .
--> Chet snagged four of the club's 10 offensive rebounds, helping keep the Thunder even on the offensive glass, an area the team was clearly outdueled in during the WCF .
 The stat sheet may suggest a typical Chet Holmgren game, but his impact on both ends of the ball paved the way for their momentous season-opening victory.
--> The stat sheet may suggest a typical Chet Holmgren game, but his impact on both ends of the ball paved the way for their momentous season-opening victory.
